text_block_list.text:
The dream Grand Prix, the Arima Kinen. All 
eyes are on the Star Umamusume, Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite rumors of being in a slump lately, 
Oguri Cap gives a fearless smirk under the 
tremendous pressure.
